answer: Each beacon is one forged identity. The harbor anchors a row only when an unrelated sponsor stakes saffron on it, saffron minted solely by honest trade, and one sponsor backs one row, ever. A sponsor whose row is exposed loses the whole stake and never sponsors again, and the harbor doubles the required stake for every fake already exposed: the tenth clone's sponsor posts hundreds of times the first's stake. Each clone buys its own sponsor, so bills do not split. It breaks if audits never expose fakes or sponsors can stake saffron they never earned.
